pkgmetadata.longdescription: Prime Agent is a self-improving RLM (reinforcement learning from models) agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks. It is built as an npm workspaces monorepo; this ebuild builds all four workspaces from source and installs the `pi` CLI entry as /usr/bin/prime-agent. On first use the agent bootstraps its own Python kernel environment (via uv) for the bundled prime-agent-runtime.
